# Units: metal (Angstroms, eV, ps, K)

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       si_structure.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Compute settings for MSD (will be used in production phase)
compute         msd_compute all msd com yes

# Thermo output settings
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol
thermo          1000

# ============================================
# Phase 1: Initial equilibration at 300K (NPT)
# ============================================
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             10000  # 10 ps equilibration at 300K
unfix           1

# ============================================
# Phase 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# ============================================
# Time needed: (2500-300)/2.2 = 1000 ps
# Steps needed: 1000 ps / 0.001 ps = 1000000 steps

fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000  # Heat for 1000 ps
unfix           2

# ============================================
# Phase 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps
# ============================================
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             500000  # Equilibrate for 500 ps
unfix           3

# ============================================
# Phase 4: Production run at 2500K with MSD calculation
# ============================================
# Reset MSD compute
reset_timestep  0

# Output MSD data
fix             4 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
fix             msd_output all ave/time 100 1 100 c_msd_compute[4] file msd_data.txt

# Run production for 500 ps to collect MSD data
run             500000

unfix           4
unfix           msd_output

print           "Simulation completed successfully"
"}

{"path": "/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_15/analyze_diffusion.py", "content": "import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')
timesteps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]

# Convert timesteps to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.001 ps, output every 100 steps
time_ps = timesteps * 0.001  # in ps

# Plot MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd, 'b-', linewidth=0.5)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time')
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('msd_analysis.png', dpi=300)
plt.close()

# For diffusion coefficient calculation, we need to fit the linear region
# MSD = 6*D*t (for 3D diffusion)
# D = MSD / (6*t)

# Skip initial equilibration - use data from 100 ps onwards
skip_time = 100  # ps
start_idx = np.argmax(time_ps >= skip_time)

# Fit linear region
time_fit = time_ps[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t + b
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# slope = 6*D (in Angstrom²/ps)
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D (m²/s) = D (Angstrom²/ps) * (1e-10 m / 1 Angstrom)² / (1e-12 s / 1 ps)
# D (m²/s) = D (Angstrom²/ps) * 1e-20 / 1e-12
# D (m²/s) = D (Angstrom²/ps) * 1e-8

D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Linear fit from {skip_time} ps onwards:")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom²/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Angstrom²")
print(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"D = {D_A2_ps:.6f} Angstrom²/ps")
print(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")

# Save result
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"Linear fit from {skip_time} ps onwards\n")
    f.write(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Angstrom²\n")
    f.write(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"\nD = {D_A2_ps:.6f} Angstrom²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s\n")
    f.write(f"\nFinal answer (m²/s): {D_m2_s:.6e}\n")

# Plot with fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd, 'b-', linewidth=0.5, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (R² = {r_value**2:.4f})')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)')
plt.title(f'MSD vs Time - D = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('msd_with_fit.png', dpi=300)
plt.close()

print(f"\nPlots saved: msd_analysis.png, msd_with_fit.png")
print(f"Results saved: diffusion_coefficient.txt")
"}

{"path": "/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_21/calculate_diffusion.py", "content": "import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the MSD data
data = pd.read_csv('msd_data.csv')

# Extract time (in ps) and MSD (in Angstrom^2)
time_ps = data['Step'].values * 0.001  # Convert steps to ps (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
msd_angstrom2 = data['c_msd[4]'].values

# Skip initial transient - use linear region
# Typically skip first 10-20% of data
skip_fraction = 0.1
start_idx = int(len(time_ps) * skip_fraction)

# Use linear region for fitting
time_fit = time_ps[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd_angstrom2[start_idx:]

# Fit linear regression to MSD vs time
# MSD = 6*D*t, so slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2 / ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
D_angstrom2_per_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12)
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * 1e-8
D_m2_per_s = D_angstrom2_per_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom2_per_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_per_s:.6e} m^2/s")

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_angstrom2, 'b-', label='MSD data', linewidth=1)
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.3f})', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'Mean Squared Displacement at 2500K\nD = {D_m2_per_s:.3e} m^2/s', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save result to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{D_m2_per_s:.6e}\n")
print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
"}

Perfect! The MSD data has been collected. Now I need to calculate the diffusion coefficient using the Einstein relation. The diffusion coefficient is calculated from the slope of MSD vs time:

D = MSD / (6t)

where MSD is in Ångström² and t is in ps. I need to convert to m²/s.

Let me create a Python script to analyze the MSD data and calculate the diffusion coefficient:

{"path": "/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_29/analyze_msd.py", "content": "import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat', skiprows=1)
steps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]

# Convert steps to time (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
time = (steps - steps[0]) * 0.001  # in ps

# For diffusion coefficient calculation, use the linear region
# Skip initial transient (first 20% of data)
# Use middle portion for linear fit
start_idx = int(0.2 * len(time))
end_idx = int(0.9 * len(time))

time_fit = time[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd[start_idx:end_idx]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6Dt (in 3D)
# Slope = 6D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12)
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * 1e-8
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer (scientific notation): {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', label='MSD data', linewidth=0.5)
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', 
         label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.3f} Å²/ps)', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)')
plt.title(f'Mean Squared Displacement vs Time\nD = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")
"}

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Units: metal (ps, eV, Angstroms, etc.)

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       silicon.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# ===== Stage 1: Initial minimization =====
minimize        1.0e-4 1.0e-6 1000 10000

# ===== Stage 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps =====
# Heating time: (2500-300)/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             1000000
unfix           1

# ===== Stage 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps =====
fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             500000
unfix           2

# ===== Stage 4: Production run with MSD calculation =====
# Run for additional 500 ps to calculate MSD
reset_timestep  0

# Compute MSD
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
fix             msd_output all print 100 "$(step) $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" &
                file msd.dat screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"

run             500000

unfix           3
unfix           msd_output

print           "Simulation complete"

Perfect! Now I'll create a LAMMPS input script for the simulation. The script needs to:
1. Replicate the structure 3x3x3
2. Heat from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps using NPT
3. Equilibrate at 2500K for 500 ps
4. Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient calculation

{"path": "/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_36/silicon_melting.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Calculate self-diffusion coefficient at 2500K

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       si.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Set neighbor list
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Compute initial temperature
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# Thermodynamic output settings
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol
thermo          1000

# Stage 1: Heat from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps under NPT
# Temperature change: 2200 K
# Rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Time needed: 2200/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1000000 fs
# Timestep: 1 fs
timestep        1.0

fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             1000000
unfix           1

# Stage 2: Equilibrate at 2500K for 500 ps under NPT
fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             500000
unfix           2

# Stage 3: Production run to compute MSD for diffusion coefficient
# Reset time and compute MSD
reset_timestep  0

# Compute MSD for all atoms
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
fix             msd_output all print 100 "$(step) $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" &
                file msd.dat screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"

# Run for 500 ps to collect MSD data
thermo          1000
run             500000

unfix           3
unfix           msd_output

print           "Simulation completed successfully"
"}

units           metal

timestep        0.001

thermo          1000

run             500000

# Clean up
unfix           4
unfix           msd_output

print           "Simulation complete"

{"path": "/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_40/analyze_diffusion.py", "content": "import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_40/msd_data.txt')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]

# Time in ps (timestep = 0.001 ps)
time = steps * 0.001

# Fit linear region to get diffusion coefficient
# Skip initial non-linear region (first 50 ps or so)
# Use data from 50 ps to 500 ps for fitting
start_idx = 50  # 50 ps / 0.001 ps per step / 1000 steps per output = index 50
end_idx = len(time)

time_fit = time[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd[start_idx:end_idx]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# So slope = 6*D, therefore D = slope/6
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Å²/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0  # Å²/ps

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Å = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Å²/ps = (1e-10)² / (1e-12) m²/s = 1e-20 / 1e-12 m²/s = 1e-8 m²/s
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Linear fit slope: {slope:.6f} Å²/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom_ps:.6f} Å²/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")

# Plot MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', label=f'Linear fit (D = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_40/msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved to msd_plot.png")

# Save result to file
with open('/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_40/diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient (numerical): {D_m2_s}\n")

print(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")
"}

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting and diffusion coefficient calculation

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

replicate       3 3 3

pair_style      sw

neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

unfix           1

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_47/msd.dat', skiprows=2)

# Extract time (in ps) and MSD (in Angstrom^2)
# timestep 0.001 ps, output every 100 steps = 0.1 ps

D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

print(f"\nResults saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")

# Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps under NPT, then equilibration

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       silicon.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep (in ps for metal units)
timestep        0.001

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient calculation
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal c_msd[4]

unfix           1

fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

unfix           2

# Run for additional 500 ps to get good MSD statistics

reset_timestep  0
compute         msd_prod all msd com yes

data = pd.read_csv('/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_53/equilibration_data.csv')

# Extract Step and MSD columns
step = data['Step'].values

time_ps = step * 0.001

# Plot MSD vs time to visualize
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)')

n_half = len(time_ps) // 2
time_fit = time_ps[n_half:]
msd_fit = msd[n_half:]

# slope = 6D

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the equilibration data
data = pd.read_csv('/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_53/equilibration_data.csv')

# Extract Step and MSD columns
step = data['Step'].values
msd = data['c_msd[4]'].values

# Convert step to time (timestep = 0.001 ps)
time_ps = step * 0.001

# Plot MSD vs time to visualize
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd, 'b-', linewidth=0.5)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time')
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_53/msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
plt.close()

# For diffusion coefficient, we use the linear regime (typically after initial transient)
# Let's use the second half of the data to ensure we're in the diffusive regime
n_half = len(time_ps) // 2
time_fit = time_ps[n_half:]
msd_fit = msd[n_half:]

# Perform linear fit: MSD = 6Dt
# slope = 6D
from scipy import stats
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0

print(f"Linear fit using data from {time_fit[0]:.1f} to {time_fit[-1]:.1f} ps")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Ų/ps")
print(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_A2_ps:.6e} Ų/ps")

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# 1 Ų/ps = (1e-10 m)² / (1e-12 s) = 1e-20 / 1e-12 m²/s = 1e-8 m²/s
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")
print(f"In scientific notation: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Also calculate using the entire dataset for comparison
slope_all, intercept_all, r_value_all, p_value_all, std_err_all = stats.linregress(time_ps, msd)
D_A2_ps_all = slope_all / 6.0
D_m2_s_all = D_A2_ps_all * 1e-8

print(f"\n--- Using entire dataset ---")
print(f"Slope: {slope_all:.6f} Ų/ps")
print(f"R²: {r_value_all**2:.6f}")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s_all:.6e} m²/s")

# Plot with linear fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd, 'b-', linewidth=0.5, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (second half): D = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s')
plt.plot(time_ps, slope_all * time_ps + intercept_all, 'g--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (all data): D = {D_m2_s_all:.2e} m²/s')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time with Linear Fits')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_53/msd_fit.png', dpi=150)
plt.close()

print(f"\nPlots saved to:")
print(f"  - msd_plot.png")
print(f"  - msd_fit.png")

# Save the result
with open('/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_53/diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient (using second half of data): {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient (using all data): {D_m2_s_all:.6e} m²/s\n")
    f.write(f"\nFinal result: {D_m2_s:.2e}\n")

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', skiprows=1)
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Column 4 is MSD_total

# Convert steps to time (dt = 0.001 ps)
time_ps = steps * 0.001  # in picoseconds

# Fit the linear region of MSD vs time to get diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6, where slope is from MSD = 6*D*t
# We'll use the last 70% of the data for fitting (more equilibrated)
fit_start = int(len(time_ps) * 0.3)
time_fit = time_ps[fit_start:]
msd_fit = msd_total[fit_start:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2 / ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D_angstrom2_per_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12)
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * 1e-8
D_m2_per_s = D_angstrom2_per_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom2_per_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_per_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer (in scientific notation): {D_m2_per_s:.2e}")

# Plot MSD vs time with fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', label='MSD data', linewidth=1)
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', 
         label=f'Linear fit (last 70%)\nD = {D_m2_per_s:.2e} m²/s', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time for Liquid Si at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save the result to a file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{D_m2_per_s:.2e}\n")
print("Result saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation

"""
Calculate self-diffusion coefficient from MSD data using Einstein relation.

In LAMMPS metal units:
- MSD is in Angstrom^2
- time is in picoseconds
- D will be in Angstrom^2/ps

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data

steps = data[:, 0]

time = (steps - 1000000) * 0.001  # time in ps

# Remove the first point (step 1000000) as it's essentially zero MSD
time = time[1:]
msd = msd[1:]

# Perform linear fit to MSD vs time to get slope
# MSD = 6Dt, so slope = 6D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time, msd, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Task: Calculate self-diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data silicon.data
replicate 3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor list settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep 0.001  # 1 fs

# Output settings
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Heating phase: 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# Temperature change: 2200 K
# Rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Time required: 2200 / 2.2 = 1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps

velocity all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run 1000000
unfix 1

# Equilibration phase: 500 ps at 2500K under NPT
reset_timestep 0
fix 2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run 500000
unfix 2

# Production phase with MSD calculation
# Run for additional time to collect MSD data
reset_timestep 0

# Compute MSD for all atoms
compute msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix 3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol c_msd[4]

# Run for 500 ps to collect MSD data
dump 1 all custom 10000 dump.silicon.lammpstrj id type x y z
dump_modify 1 sort id
run 500000

# Output final MSD values
variable msd_final equal c_msd[4]
print "Final MSD: ${msd_final}"

write_data final_structure.data

## Task
Calculate the average self-diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K using molecular dynamics simulations with LAMMPS.

## Simulation Details

### System Setup
- **Material**: Silicon (mp-149 from Materials Project)
- **Structure**: Conventional crystallographic structure
- **System size**: 3×3×3 replication of unit cell
- **Potential**: Stillinger-Weber (SW) potential for silicon
- **Units**: metal (Angstrom, eV, ps, K, bar)
- **Atom style**: full
- **Boundary conditions**: periodic in all directions
- **Timestep**: 1 fs (0.001 ps)

### Simulation Protocol

1. **Initial equilibration** (10 ps)
   - Temperature: 300K
   - Ensemble: NPT (P = 0 bar, isotropic)
   - Duration: 10,000 steps

2. **Heating phase** (1000 ps)
   - Temperature ramp: 300K → 2500K
   - Heating rate: 2.2 K/ps
   - Ensemble: NPT (P = 0 bar, isotropic)
   - Duration: 1,000,000 steps

3. **Equilibration at 2500K** (500 ps)
   - Temperature: 2500K
   - Ensemble: NPT (P = 0 bar, isotropic)
   - Duration: 500,000 steps

4. **Production run** (100 ps)
   - Temperature: 2500K
   - Ensemble: NPT (P = 0 bar, isotropic)
   - Duration: 100,000 steps
   - MSD computation: enabled with COM correction
   - Output frequency: every 100 steps (0.1 ps)

## Results

### Diffusion Coefficient Calculation

The self-diffusion coefficient was calculated using the Einstein relation:

**D = MSD / (6t)**

where:
- MSD = mean squared displacement
- t = time
- The factor of 6 comes from 3D diffusion

### Linear Fit Analysis
- **Slope of MSD vs time**: 9.372204 Å²/ps
- **Diffusion coefficient**: 1.562034 Å²/ps
- **Diffusion coefficient**: **1.562034×10⁻⁸ m²/s**

### Unit Conversion
- 1 Å² = 10⁻²⁰ m²
- 1 ps = 10⁻¹² s
- Therefore: 1 Å²/ps = 10⁻⁸ m²/s

## Final Answer

**Self-diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K: 1.56×10⁻⁸ m²/s**

## Notes

1. The MSD data shows good linear behavior after the initial transient period
2. The linear fit was performed on 90% of the data (excluding the first 10% to remove transient effects)
3. The system was well-equilibrated at 2500K before the production run
4. The Stillinger-Weber potential is a well-established empirical potential for silicon
5. The diffusion coefficient is reasonable for liquid silicon at this temperature

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting and diffusion calculation
# Units: metal (Angstroms, eV, ps, K, bars)

units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       silicon.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Time step
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Heating phase: 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# Temperature change = 2200K
# Rate = 2.2 K/ps, so time = 2200/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             1000000
unfix           1

# Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps = 500,000 steps
fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             500000
unfix           2

# Reset timestep for MSD calculation
reset_timestep  0

# Production run with MSD calculation
# Run for another 500 ps to collect MSD data
compute         msd all msd com yes
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

# Output MSD data every 100 steps
fix             msd_output all print 100 "$(step) $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" &
                file msd.dat screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"

dump            1 all custom 10000 dump.lammpstrj id type x y z
run             500000
